title: JIBALI — من قلب الجبل، لقلب البيت.

delivery.note: 720p AI sources resized locally to 1080x1920; not native 1080p detail. No paid upscaling or 4K.

style: Ultra-photoreal cinematic Lebanese heritage. Authentic Mount Hermon and Rashaya references, warm restrained sunrise light, limestone and wheat tones. Consistent Eurasian hoopoe with orange-buff body, barred wings, slender curved bill and black-tipped crest. Natural physics, gentle camera movement, no cartoon effects or morph transitions.

voice.script: جبالي… من قلب الجبل، لقلب البيت.
voice.pronunciation: Jibāli … min ʔalb ij-jabal, la-ʔalb il-bēt (Lebanese: ق spoken as a glottal stop).
voice.delivery: Lebanese dialect. Warm, close, unhurried, mid-low register. A pause of about 0.3 s after جبالي. Storyteller, not announcer.
voice.source_preference: Real Lebanese voice recorded on a phone (free). See audio/VOICE-RECORDING-GUIDE.md.
voice.fallback: AI text-to-speech (ElevenLabs Multilingual v2 on fal) only with separate spending approval; expect formal-Arabic rather than Lebanese pronunciation.
voice.aligned_with: closing-titles.ass (17-20 s). The spoken words must match the on-screen words exactly.

music.brief: Sparse Levantine instrumental: solo oud with a soft ney breath and a very light frame-drum pulse. Dawn mood, slow (about 70 BPM), no vocals, no modern beat. Builds gently and resolves on a warm final note at about 19.5 s.
music.mix: Fade in 0-1.5 s, fade out 19.0-20.0 s, ducked under the voice automatically.
music.source_preference: Local oud player recording (owned outright), else an AI-generated track (Stable Audio 2.5 on fal), else a library track with confirmed commercial-use licence.
music.licence_rule: No non-commercial (NC) or unclear-licence music. If posted with Instagram's in-app library on a business account, only Meta Sound Collection is cleared.

sound_effects.method: Video-to-audio (MMAudio v2 on fal) run on each trimmed silent scene clip, so the sounds line up with the picture; or commercially cleared library sounds.
sound_effects.files: audio/sfx/<scene id>.wav, each starting at its scene start; see audio-timeline.csv
sound_effects.licence_rule: Hoopoe call must be CC0/commercially cleared or generated. Most free bird recordings (e.g. xeno-canto) are non-commercial and must not be used.
sound_effects.scene_06: No sound effects under the product reveal; music and voice only.

mix.loudness: -14 LUFS integrated, -1 dBTP true peak (Instagram/TikTok/YouTube Shorts)
mix.export: Copy the video stream untouched; add exactly one audio stream; final duration exactly 20.000 s.

shots.method: One Wan clip, trim four seconds
shots.prompt: Use supplied Hermon photo as geography reference. One realistic hoopoe flies across the foreground above rugged Mount Hermon at sunrise. Gentle aerial drift, plausible wingbeats, consistent bird anatomy. No scene transformation.
shots.source_status: Mountain reference exists; bird-in-landscape keyframe still required.

shots.method: One Wan clip, trim three seconds
shots.prompt: Same hoopoe descends onto a small limestone in a golden Lebanese mountain wheat field. Feet contact stone and wings fold naturally. Slight wheat movement. No change in feather pattern.
shots.source_status: Create keyframe using first bird keyframe for identity consistency.

shots.method: One Wan clip, trim three seconds
shots.prompt: Close detail of a physically plausible traditional horizontal stone grain mill. Kernels feed at the center while bran-flecked whole-wheat flour exits below. Gentle stone rotation, modest falling flour. No magical transformation.
shots.source_status: Create corrected keyframe; previous upright-wheel storyboard is not a reliable grain-mill mechanism.

shots.method: Two brief still inserts then one kneading clip

inserts.action: Close photograph of pinch of salt entering flour; subtle local push-in
Close photograph of water pouring into same flour bowl; subtle local push-in

shots.prompt: Same artisan hands knead flour-water-salt dough in a rustic bowl in a modest Lebanese kitchen. Small plausible hand movement, stable fingers and bowl. No extra ingredients, yeast, starter, fermentation or rising.
shots.source_status: Three related keyframes required. Salt and water are photographic inserts, not fully animated pouring shots.

shots.method: One Wan clip, trim four seconds
shots.prompt: Extremely thin whole-wheat Lebanese saj cooks on a convex metal griddle over a small controlled wood fire. Small bubbles and golden spots, delicate porous texture matching supplied bread photo. Subtle heat shimmer, no large flames, thick pita or toppings.
shots.source_status: Use supplied bread texture reference to create accurate saj keyframe.

shots.method: Original product photo, free local push-in inside a composed end card (scripts/render-scene-06.py); no paid generation
shots.prompt: Orient original photograph upright and crop conservatively. Keep exact original green-and-gold package, Arabic bird logo, label text, product geometry and proportions. Do not repaint or reconstruct label. Place restrained closing typography only in clean space.
shots.status: DONE 2026-11-22: output/brand-film-45/scenes/06-product-reveal.mp4 (clean, 72 frames, no audio) and 06-product-reveal-titled-preview.mp4 (closing titles burned in, preview only).
shots.layout: A full-frame 9:16 push-in would crop the label (it fills ~72% of the photo width), so the photo sits in a 1080x1350 (4:5) panel with a ~1.13x ease-out push-in that keeps the whole label in frame on every frame, above a 2 px gold rule and a band in the label's own green (sampled from the photo: RGB 45,101,96; gold 206,162,115). Closing titles sit in that band, clear of the bottom ~320 px Reels interface. Pixels come only from cropping/resizing the original photo: no repainting or colour grading.
